name: Drug Use Motives (DUM)
instruction: Rate each statement using the answer scale provided.

1.text: People take drugs when they are available and there is money.

2.text: People try drugs to understand what others feel.

3.text: Taking drugs is a personal matter; everyone makes their own choice.

4.text: Drugs give a 'high', mental and physical pleasure.

5.text: Drugs relieve inner tension, anxiety, fear and worry.

6.text: Taking drugs gets rid of boredom, emptiness and loneliness.

7.text: To feel 'normal', you need to take a certain dose of a drug.

8.text: The best way to stop thinking about drugs is to take them.

9.text: People take drugs out of spite, to annoy those around them.

10.text: People take drugs out of spite, to annoy those around them.

11.text: In a group, people take drugs so as not to spoil relations with friends by refusing.

12.text: Drugs are no more dangerous than tobacco and alcohol.

13.text: People take drugs out of curiosity, to test themselves and try new, unknown sensations.

14.text: Taking drugs is a way to escape reality and the daily grind.

15.text: Drugs are needed to change your state and sharpen your senses and interest in life.

16.text: Taking a drug helps you get over withdrawal.

17.text: People take drugs knowing they are dependent on them.

18.text: Drug use is caused by losing the meaning of life.

19.text: Taking drugs when meeting friends gets rid of boredom and idleness.

20.text: People take drugs so as not to look 'weak'.

21.text: You can take drugs without becoming dependent.

22.text: A drug lets a person experience well-being and happiness.

23.text: Drugs help you forget conflicts with loved ones, unpleasant events, grief and disappointment.

24.text: The world of dreams and fantasies created by drugs stimulates spiritual life and fills an inner emptiness.

25.text: Not having a dose causes inner tension, anxiety and apathy.

26.text: People increase the dose because they can't overcome their craving for the pleasure it gives.

27.text: People take drugs out of a spirit of defiance towards society, not wanting to be good, proper and like everyone else.

28.text: Taking drugs makes you stand out from the crowd and look especially 'cool'.

29.text: People take drugs in company so as not to feel awkward or be the odd one out.

30.text: Taking drugs is a form of self-expression.

31.text: Taking drugs makes for a pleasant, fun time and socializing, and helps you relax.

32.text: Being unable to meet your needs or sort out your personal life forces people to take drugs.

33.text: A drug adds strength and energy, excites, activates and acts as a stimulant.

34.text: After taking a drug your mood improves and your capacity for work is restored.

35.text: Having a dose makes you want to take it immediately.

36.text: Being misunderstood and not believed in by others forces people to take drugs.

37.text: Taking drugs is prestigious and earns respect from others.

38.text: People take drugs under peer pressure or as a result of coercion.

40.text: The first experience of pleasure from a drug makes people repeat it again and again.

41.text: Taking drugs eases negative feelings caused by lack of money, relationship problems and so on.

42.text: Drugs make you feel strong and free.

43.text: Each new, larger dose brings new, stronger sensations of pleasure.

44.text: You can feel something like 'love' for a drug: constantly longing for it, missing it and enjoying each encounter.

45.text: Losing sight of the future and of the meaning and value of life forces people to take drugs.
